statements.impact_statement: Ubuntu's official CVE-2026-109518 advisory identifies 2.8.4ubuntu0.1 as the Ubuntu 24.04 fix: https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-109518 . The NVIDIA build upgrades OS packages and verify_apt.py checks both installed package versions using Debian version comparison. Package acquisition disables retries before the old client is upgraded, excluding the advisory's required non-zero Acquire::Retries condition. This statement matches only these exact fixed package PURLs; it does not cover the vulnerable upstream CPU images, other versions, architectures or CVEs. Raw and assessed findings remain in the Trivy JSON report while scanner metadata catches up.
